conbody.p: Forward Attention Warning uses the in-cabin camera to help prevent the driver from being distracted while driving with an audible warning and warning light.

section.title: Detecting sensor
section.p: The picture above shows the detailed location of the detecting sensor.

li.p: Always keep the in-cabin camera in good condition to maintain optimal performance of Forward Attention Warning.

If the inside rear view mirror is excessively tilted, causing the in-cabin camera to be out of range and unable to detect the driver, Forward Attention Warning may not operate properly, and may display Limitations of Forward Attention Warning message.

If the in-cabin camera is excessively tilted or obstructed by objects, the Forward Attention Warning may not operate properly, and a warning light and warning message appear on the instrument cluster.
